summary: Added the generic Sentry-v8 tracing capability to @versionless/angular following the ngrx idiom: migrateSentryV8Tracing rewrites @sentry/tracing BrowserTracing constructions into @sentry/angular's browserTracingIntegration, folds away a binding-resolved routingInstrumentation, and relocates tracingOrigins to tracePropagationTargets on the enclosing binding-resolved Sentry.init, refusing (leaving whole and reporting) unresolvable inits, non-plain literals, pre-existing tracePropagationTargets, contested inits, foreign bindings, and unnamable factories. Wired into index.ts and the composed era migration. 20 new tests. Verified read-only against the staged @sentry/angular@8.55.2 types; no closure writes, no builds. tsc, vp lint and vp test --project node (1067 tests) all green.
